title: Explain the versioned headless delivery contract for applications
description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a application developer, I want a minimal versioned delivery guide, so that I can integrate without relying on internal CMS models.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Explain the versioned headless delivery contract for applications
  Scenario: Follow a delivery integration guide
    Given a verified delivery contract
    When I follow its article and listing examples
    Then I can identify versioned fields, the Markus body string, public assets, filters and pagination
    And identity, missing or withdrawn content, update consistency and caching behavior are documented
    And examples disclose neither drafts nor credentials or private editorial fields
    And deferred formats, Contentful compatibility and authenticated previews are not presented as requirements
```

Keep examples and contract field names synchronized with implemented capability; this planning record does not select routes or a backend. Explain shared published-content foundation and relation to existing M8 JSON.

Also document automatic public-change refresh when headless outputs are enabled, including publish, saved published edits and unpublish, common published selection with feeds and sitemap, private-draft isolation, observable completion/failure and retry/reconciliation. Link PPY-defff04e-17b5-4e28-9bb5-df412601a102. Orchestration/atomicity and exact APIs remain design decisions until verified.

Approved dependency-guide correction: explain automatic extraction from supported declarative listing/embedded-content constructs at save/compile time and the generated reverse index. Rendering selection is the only source of type/featured parameters; no duplicated manual per-page rules. Cover union across components, old-or-new published-state matching for additions/removals/type/featured changes, and replacement/removal of stale page registrations. Publication visibility is enforced separately. Record unsupported custom-query fallback, exact extension ownership and schema syntax as open design questions. Anth.us main currently generates custom Python listing fragments and hashes them for incremental invalidation; do not present the proposed generic construct or reverse index as already implemented. See foundation PPY-3f55c3 and story PPY-defff0 for pinned source evidence.
